---
title: "Talks"
---

Slides from invited talks and keynotes, shared under
[CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) --- please adapt and
reuse them.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
This page starts from August 2026. Talks from 2023 to mid-2026 are archived on
the [Open Science Framework](https://osf.io/cxryb/) and remain freely available
there.
:::

## Earlier talks
